annotations.text:
EQ tab settled through v5 (arc gauges, type dropdowns, bidirectional graph-strip editing).

NEW: Clip Studio v1 (below) — Resolve-inspired: media pool left; spectrogram (dark scope) + waveform stacked, swappable Wave/Spec/Both; timeline with in/out, markers, tagged clip spans; box-select a time-x-frequency moment on the spectrogram; inspector with tags + notes; A/B bar grows transport during a track session. Everything saves to the local database.

Older v2 notes:

· One-row header: wordmark, tabs, device chip. Wasted upper-left gone.
· The filter rail is dead. Filters ARE the graph now — handles on the curve, each filter's own curve drawn faint, the selected one edited in the strip below. Chips row = quick selection, ordered per your Settings toggle.
· Denser graph: 3/6 dB rules, ten labeled frequency lines.
· Blind test moved out of the corner into the BENCH — a bar docked at the bottom of every tab: A/B state, hotkey, level-match status, Load a track, Blind test.
· Preset line now carries the history tree (12 steps · 2 branches) and auto-preamp.

Settings unchanged — you liked it.
